# Infinitum Defense

> Executive protection, armed tactical response, event security, secure transport and protective intelligence from Washington, D.C. Open 24/7. Free consultation.

Infinitum Defense (Infinitum Defense Contracting Inc.) is the defensive arm of Infinitum Corporation, headquartered in Washington, D.C. The operations desk is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Contracts run from a single day to indefinitely and start with a free consultation. The site is available in English and Russian.

## Services

- [Physical Protection](https://infinitumdefense.com/services/physical-protection): Site and perimeter security, access control and threat response for property and people in Washington, D.C. One day or ongoing contracts. Open 24/7, free consultation.
- [Executive Protection](https://infinitumdefense.com/services/executive-protection): Close protection details, travel and movement planning, and risk assessment for executives, principals and their families. Washington, D.C., 24/7. Free consultation.
- [Event Security](https://infinitumdefense.com/services/event-security): Guest screening, credentialing, crowd management and venue coordination for private functions and large events in Washington, D.C. Open 24/7, free consultation.
- [Armed Tactical Response](https://infinitumdefense.com/services/armed-security): Licensed armed officers with military and law-enforcement backgrounds, rapid response teams and lockdown support for high-threat situations. Washington, D.C., 24/7.
- [Secure Transport & Convoy](https://infinitumdefense.com/services/secure-transport): Planned, escorted movement for people and high-value assets: armored and escort vehicles, route reconnaissance and advance teams. Washington, D.C., 24/7.
- [Protective Intelligence](https://infinitumdefense.com/services/protective-intelligence): Threat and vulnerability assessments, open-source monitoring and pre-deployment briefings that identify threats before they reach your door. Washington, D.C.
- [Critical Infrastructure Protection](https://infinitumdefense.com/services/critical-infrastructure-protection): Layered security for data centers, utilities, logistics hubs and government-adjacent sites: perimeter patrols, command post staffing and surveillance detection.
- [Tactical Training](https://infinitumdefense.com/services/security-training): Practical training for staff and security teams: active-threat response drills, tactical first aid and security team readiness. Washington, D.C.

## Frequently asked questions

- What security services does Infinitum Defense provide? Physical protection, executive protection, event security, armed tactical response, secure transport, protective intelligence, critical infrastructure protection and tactical training, plus security consulting.
- Where are you based? Infinitum Defense is headquartered in Washington, D.C., and is the defensive arm of Infinitum Corporation.
- Are you available outside business hours? Yes. Our operations desk is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and holidays.
- How long are contracts? From a single day to indefinitely. The same team can cover one event, a tense week or a permanent post.
- How do we start? Book a free consultation. We assess the threat with you and reply with a written plan covering staffing, posts and timeline.
